resemblance_review.reviewed_by: PlotNua build session (side-by-side comparison, board h6-retreat-resemblance-board-2026-10-26.png, kept with the founder release folder PlotNua-H6-Release-2026-10-26, not in this repository); accepted by Colin MacAulay (founder) on 26 Oct 2026 as a review, not as a claim that a conventional hot tub design is proprietary
resemblance_review.compared_against: The licensed supplier photographs carried in the live Garden Retreat composite (possibility-reveal-L6: the supplier's cube sauna with a lit full-height glass front, and its wood-fired hot tub with an internal snorkel stove); board: retreat-resemblance-board.png
findings: Shares only generic features of the category: a timber sauna cabin, a round timber hot tub, a stove chimney with steam
Sauna form differs: a tall, narrow, light vertical-board cabin with one narrow upright window, not a wide dark-clad cube with a full-height glass front
Hot tub differs: an external free-standing black stove beside the tub, not the supplier's internal snorkel stove in the water; plain vertical staves with no visible bands
Setting and composition differ: evening planting bed and fence corner at the far right of a lawn, not a paved terrace with stepping stones and a red maple
resemblance_review.verdict: No distinctive design element of the compared supplier products is reproduced. The features shared (a timber sauna cabin, a round timber hot tub, a stove flue) are generic to the category.
